title: Movie watching and recognition memory: depth-electrode macro iEEG from Keles et al. 2024 (DANDI 000623)
description: Intracranial EEG recorded from clinical macroelectrode contacts of hybrid Behnke-Fried depth electrodes in 16 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy at Cedars-Sinai Medical Center. Participants passively watched an edited 8-minute excerpt of Hitchcock's "Bang! You're Dead" and then completed a new/old recognition memory test on movie frames with confidence ratings. Electrodes sampled amygdala, hippocampus, medial frontal cortex and lateral cortex. This iEEG-BIDS representation converts the macroelectrode field potentials from the DANDI 000623 NWB release without altering signal values.
methods_description: Macro channels were acquired with a Neuralynx ATLAS system at 2000 Hz, low-pass filtered at 500 Hz, and decimated to 1000 Hz. Recordings were cropped by the original authors to 10 s before movie onset through 10 s after the end of the task. The NWB LFP_macro ElectricalSeries was written to BrainVision float32 microvolts without filtering, resampling, re-referencing or channel removal. Trials, TTL markers and movie-frame times were mapped to BIDS events.
